title: A classification of zero $p$-rank curves with large automorphism groups in odd characteristic
summary: Let $\cX$ be a curve of genus $g\ge2$ and $p$-rank zero over an algebraically closed field of odd characteristic $p$, and let $G\le\Aut(\cX)$ satisfy $|G|>24g(g-1)$. We prove that $G$ fixes a point unless $(\cX,G)$ belongs to an explicit list. For $g\ge4$, the curve is a cyclic quotient of a Hermitian curve, of a Giulietti--Korchmáros curve, or of Skabelund's cover of a Ree curve. We determine the equations and all the groups $G$ that occur, including their central kernels.
